additional.text: Summons 5 swirling blades of light that follow the active character for 12 seconds. The swords will deal % of attack and % of health of the equipping character as [Light] damage per hit and heal the active character for % of their max health per hit.

At any time during this skill, using the equipping character’s Special Skill will consume a single sword to increase [Light] elemental damage by +% for self, lasting 5 seconds. This is stackable, up to 3 times.

Increases health and attack by +%. Whenever the equipping character’s [Shield] breaks or ends, they will consume 15% of their health. Each consumed instance will heal allies and self equal to % of the value of health consumed after a delay of 3 seconds. Between that time, the equipping character is immune to incoming damage (debuffs may still apply and activate).
Every point on the light meter will increase the party’s all elemental damage by +% for the meter’s duration, capped at +%.
